name: Dedan
overview: Dedan appears in Scripture both as a descendant of Raamah and Jokshan, highlighting its roots in the genealogies of Genesis. It also refers to a people or country likely bordering Edom, as indicated by prophetic judgments against Dedan linked with Edom's calamity. Additionally, Dedan is depicted as a merchant people involved in trade, supplying valuable goods such as ivory, ebony, and precious clothing, underscoring its role in ancient commerce.
